g: G is a metric unit of weight equal to one thousandth of a kilogram.
G can also mean a purine base found in DNA and RNA.
G can also mean one of the four nucleotides used in building DNA.
G means the same as gram or gramme or gm.
g-force: A g-force is a unit of force equal to the force exerted by gravity.
G-force means the same as g or gee.
g-jo: G-Jo is treatment of symptoms by applying pressure with the fingers to specific pressure points on the body.
G-Jo means the same as acupressure or shiatsu.
g-man: G-man is a special law-enforcement agent of the Federal Bureau of Investigation.
G-man means the same as FBI agent or government man.
g-string: G-string is minimal clothing worn by stripteasers.
G-string means the same as thong.
g. b. shaw: G. B. Shaw is British playwright.
G. B. Shaw means the same as Shaw or George Bernard Shaw.
g. e. moore: G. E. Moore is English philosopher.
G. E. Moore means the same as Moore or George Edward Moore.
g. k. chesterton: G. K. Chesterton is conservative English writer of the Roman Catholic persuasion.
G. K. Chesterton means the same as Chesterton or Gilbert Keith Chesterton.
g. l. von blucher: the word G. L. von Blucher
G. L. von Blucher is Prussian general who is remembered for his leadership in the wars against Napoleon.
G. L. von Blucher means the same as Blucher or von Blucher or Gebhard Leberecht von Blucher.
g. r. kirchhoff: G. R. Kirchhoff is German physicist who with Bunsen pioneered spectrum analysis and formulated two laws governing electric networks.
G. R. Kirchhoff means the same as Kirchhoff or Gustav Robert Kirchhoff.
g. stanley hall: G. Stanley Hall is United States child psychologist whose theories of child psychology strongly influenced educational psychology.
G. Stanley Hall means the same as Hall or Granville Stanley Hall.
g clef: G clef is a clef that puts the G above middle C on the second line of a staff.
G clef means the same as treble clef or treble staff.
g suit: G suit is pressure suit worn by fliers and astronauts to counteract the forces of gravity and acceleration.
G suit means the same as anti-G suit.
To G.I. means to clean in preparation for inspection.
For example: "The soldiers GIed the barracks."
G.I. means the same as GI.
